run_reval_cli: run the reval script to re-evaluate saved detections from a results directory
run_reval_with_dataset: run re-evaluation on a specific dataset like coco_2014_test using the reval tool
run_reval_matlab: run re-evaluation using matlab for evaluation by passing the --matlab flag
run_reval_competition_mode: run re-evaluation in competition mode by passing the --comp flag to reval
run_reval_with_cfg: run re-evaluation with an optional config file by passing the --cfg flag
